These closing Visions and Consolations are singularly striking, and afford scope for copious illustration; but as our COMMENTATOR did not live to expound them, it would in become his Translator to obtrude on the reader his own research into these deep things of the Spirit of God.

A minute description of *The Temple Scenery* has been attempted by a learned Jew, SOLOMAN BENNETT, R.A. of Berlin, (Edit. London, 1834.) His work contains a most elaborate account of every interesting particular. Ezekiel 40, Ezekiel 41, and Ezekiel 42 are explained verse by verse; and a ground-plan and bird’s-eye view are subjoined.

These chapters are also explained by FRY on *The Second Advent*, volume 1. Section 13.

<!-- PAGE 751 -->

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1">A TRANSLATION OF THE</p>

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">FIRST TWENTY CHAPTERS</span></p>

<p class="title-block-h1" style="text-align:center; font-size:22px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#0000d4">OF THE PROPHECIES OF</span> <span style="color:#0000d4">EZEKIEL,</span></p>

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1">AS MODIFIED BY THESE COMMENTARIES.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> NOW it came to pass in the thirtieth year, <span style="color:#800000">[^f565]</span> in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> In the fifth day of the month, in the fifth year of the captivity of King Jehoiakim, <span style="color:#800000">3</span> The word of Jehovah came to Ezekiel, son of Buzi the priest, in the and of the Chaldreans, near the river Chebar, and the land of Jehovah was upon him there.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And I looked, and, behold, tempestuous wind coming from the north; a great cloud, and a fire folding round itself, and a brightness was round about it; and out of the midst there was, as it were, the appearance of Hasmal in the midst of the fire.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> And in the middle of this, was the likeness of four living creatures, and their aspect was the likeness of a man:

<!-- PAGE 752 -->
<span style="color:#800000">6</span> They had each four faces and four wings, <span style="color:#800000">7</span> Their feet were straight, and the sole of their feet like that of a calf’s foot, (or round, volume 1,) and they cast forth sparks like the appearance of polished brass:

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And they had human hands under their wings on their four sides; and they had four faces and wings.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And each wing was connected with the next wing: when they moved they did not turn back: each animal went forward in the direction of his face.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> As to the likeness of their faces, these four had the face of a man and the face of a lion on the right side; and on the left, these four had the face of an ox and the face of an eagle.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Their faces, then, and their wings were extended <span style="color:#800000">[^f566]</span> from above, and each wing was bound to its neighbor, and two covered their body.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And each walked in the direction of its face; and wheresoever the spirit (or will,) proceeded, they proceeded they did not return in their course.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> As to the likeness of the living creatures, their aspect was like coals of burning fire, like the appearance of lamps passing up and down between the living creatures: and the fire was ‘bright, and lightning’ issued from it.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> And the living creatures ran and returned like lightning.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> While I was; beholding’ the living creatures, behold one wheel on the earth, near each living, creature, at right angles, <span style="color:#800000">[^f567]</span> at the face of each.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship was like chrysolite: and they were all alike’ and their appearance and their form were like one wheel within another.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> When they moved forward, they went upon their four sides: they did not turn back when they proceeded.

<!-- PAGE 753 -->

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And I beheld their circumferences, and their size, and their terribleness; and their strakes were full of eyes, round about these four.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> And when the living creatures walked, the wheels moved beside them; and when the living creatures were raised from the earth, the wheels were raised with them. <span style="color:#800000">[^f568]</span> <span style="color:#800000">20</span> Withersoever the spirit led the living creatures, tither it also led the wheels: the wheels were raised up also with the living creatures, because their spirit was in the wheels also.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> When the animals moved forward, the wheels did the same: they both were stationary and both elevated together; because the spirit of the animals was in the wheels.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of a firmament, as the appearance of terrible crystal stretched over and above their heads.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> And under the firmament their wings were straight, each towards its neighbor: and each living creature had two wings, which covered their bodies on this side and on that.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> And I heard the voice of their wings, like the voice of mighty waters, and like the voice of God’ the voice of their speech was like the sound of an army when they moved forward; and when they stood, they let down their wings.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> And there was a voice from the firmament over their heads when they stood and let down their wings.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> And above the firmament over their heads was the likeness of a throne, like the vision of a sapphire stone: and above the likeness of the throne was an image like the aspect of a man upon it.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> And I saw, as it were, the color of amber, like the appearance of fire round about within it: from the appearance of his loins, both upwards and downwards, I saw the aspect of fire, and a brightness all round about him.

<!-- PAGE 754 -->

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> Like the appearance of a bow in a cloud on a rainy day, such was the aspect of his brightness round about. This was a vision of the similitude of Jehovah’s glory: and I gazed at it, and fell upon my face, and heard a voice speaking unto me. And he said unto me, — <span style="color:#800000">1</span> Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> And the Spirit came to me when he addressed me, and placed me upon my feet: and I heard him address me; and he said unto me — <span style="color:#800000">3</span> Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, To revolting tribes who have rebelled against me: They and their fathers have acted perfidiously against me, Even to this very day.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> They are children of a hard face, and of a stiff heart. Therefore I send thee unto them; And you shall say to them — Thus says the LORD JEHOVAH.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will not, For they are a rebellious house, Yet shall know that a Prophet has been among them.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And you, son of man, be not afraid of them; Fear not their words, though they are rebellious, And are thorns towards time, and you dwellest with scorpions. Be not afraid of their language; Be not dismayed at their looks, Since they are a rebellious house.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> And you shall utter my words unto them, Whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear; For they are rebels.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And you, son of man, hear what I say unto thee: Be not you rebellious like that. rebellious house; Open thy mouth, and eat what I put before thee.

<!-- PAGE 755 -->

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Then I looked up, and, behold, a hand extended to me; And lo! a roll of a book was in it:

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Then he spread it before my face; And lo! The roll was written behind and before, And the writing was lamentations, and morning, and wo.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> After that he said to me, Son of man, eat completely what you has found; namely, this roll, And go and speak to the house of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> So I opened my mouth, and he fed me with that roll.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And said to me, Son of man, Feed thy belly, and fill thy bowels with this roll which I give thee. So I ate it, and it was in my mouth Like honey for sweetness.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then he said to me, Son of man! Go to the house of Israel and address them in my words, <span style="color:#800000">5</span> Since you art not sent to a people profound in lip and hard of speech, You art sent to the house of Israel:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Not to many peoples profound in lip and heavy in speech, Whom you canst not understand; <span style="color:#800000">[^f569]</span> Had I sent thee unto them, they would have hearkened unto thee.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> But the house of Israel will not hear thee; Because they will not hear me; Since the whole house of Israel are hard of front and stout of heart.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Lo! I have made thy face hard against their faces, And thy forehead hard, against their forehead.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> As an adamant, harder than flint, Have I made thy forehead: fear them not: Be not broken down at their presence, For they are a house of rebellion.

<!-- PAGE 756 -->

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Moreover, he said to me, Son of man! All my words which I shall speak to thee, Receive in your heart and hear with your ears:

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And go — Judea thee to the captives, to the children of thy people, And speak unto them and tell them, — Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Whether they will hear, or whether they will not.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then the Spirit raised me up: and I heard behind me A voice of mighty rustling, which said, Blessed be the glory of Jehovah from his place!

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> 1 heard also the sound of the wings of the living’ creatures, Each kissing that of its companion, And the noise of the wheels beside them — the sound of a mighty shaking.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Then the Spirit raised me, and took me away, And I set forth in bitterness and indignation of spirit, And the hand of Jehovah was strong upon me.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Then I came to the captives at Thel-abib, They were seated by the river Chebar: there they sat: And I also sat there seven days desolate in the midst of them.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Then it happened at the end of the seven days, Thai the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">17</span> Son of man! I have appointed thee a watchman over the house of Israel; Hence you shalt hear words from my mouth, And shall warn them from me.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> When I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die: And you warnest him not, and speakest not unto him; And warnest him not from his wicked way to save his life: That wicked man shall die in his iniquity; But his blood. will I require at thy hand.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Yet if you warn the wicked, and he turn not from his impious and evil way, He shall die in his iniquity; But you has freed your own soul.

<!-- PAGE 757 -->

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> If a just man shall turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity: And I put a stumbling-block before his face, he shall die: Because you has not warned him, he shall die in his sins, The righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; But his blood will I require at thy hand.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Then if you warn the righteous that he sin not, And he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned, You also has delivered your own soul.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Then the hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he said to me, Arise, go unto the plain, and there I will speak to thee.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Then I arose, and went to the plain, and lo! The glory of Iehovah stood there, As the glory which I had beheld by the river Chebar:

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> And I fell upon my face, and the Spirit entered into me, And placed me upon my feet, and addressed me, and said, Go — shut thyself within your house.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> And now — son of man! — lo! they shall put chains upon thee, And shall bind thee with them, and you shall not go forth into the midst of them:

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Then I will make thy tongue cleave to thy palate, And you shall be dumb, and be no longer a reprover to them: Because they are a house; of rebellion.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> But when I shall speak to thee, and shall open thy mouth, You shall say unto them, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, He who hears, may hear: he who forbears, may forbear; Since they are a house of rebellion. <span style="color:#800000">[^f570]</span> <span style="color:#800000">1</span> Thou also, son of man! take thee a tile, And put it before thy face, And paint upon it the city Jerusalem:

<!-- PAGE 758 -->

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Lay siege against it, and build a tower against it: Cast a mound against it, and set a camp against it: Set battering-rams against it all round.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Then take an iron pan, and set it for a wall between thee and the city; Strengthen thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, And you shall besiege it. This is a sign to the house of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> He you also on thy left; side, and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it; According to the number of the days during which you shall he upon it You shall bear their iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> For I have appointed unto thee the years of their iniquity, According to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: Thus shall you bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And when you have finished those days, Then again you shall he on thy right side, And you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judea forty days; Each day for a year, as I have appointed thee.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then you shall direct thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, And thine arm shall be uncovered, And you shall not prophesy against it.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Lo! I have put cords upon thee, And you shall not turn from side to side Until you have fulfilled the days of thy sieges.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Take you also wheat; and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, And put them in one vessel, and make it into bread for time, According to the number of the days on which you shall he on thy side: Three hundred and ninety days shall you eat it.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> And the food which you shall eat by weight, Shall be twenty shekels a day: from time to time shall you eat it.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And water shall thou drink by measure, the sixth part of a hin: From time to time shall you drink it.

<!-- PAGE 759 -->
<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then you shall eat barley cake, and shall bake it With human dung before their eyes: And Jehovah said, <span style="color:#800000">13</span> Even thus shall the children of Israel cat their defiled bread Among the Gentiles wither I have driven them.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Then I said, Alas, O Lord Jehovah! Lo! my soul has not been polluted, And from my youth up never have I eaten What died of itself, or was torn to pieces; And abominable flesh has never entered my mouth.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Then he said, See! I have given thee The dung of oxen for that of men, And you shall cook thy bread with this. <span style="color:#800000">[^f571]</span> <span style="color:#800000">16</span> Moreover, he said to me, Son of man! Lo! I break the staff of bread in Jerusalem; And they shall eat bread by weight and with fear; And shall drink water by measure and with astonishment, <span style="color:#800000">17</span> So that bread and water shall fail them, And they shall be astonished one with another, And consume away in their iniquity. <span style="color:#800000">[^f572]</span> <span style="color:#800000">1</span> And you, son of man f take thee a sharp sword, Take thee a barber’s razor, and pass it over thy head and thy beard: Then take thee a just balance and divide the hair.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> A third part you shall burn in the midst of the city, When the days of the siege are fulfilled; A third part shall you smite about with the sword; And another third shall you scatter to the wind; And I will unsheathe the sword after them.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">3</span> Then you shall take a few of them, And bind them in thy skirts.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then take some of them. and cast them into the fire, And burn them; for thence shall fire go forth Upon all the house of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Then says the Lord Jehovah, This is Jerusalem: In the midst of the nations and of the surrounding countries Have I placed her.

<!-- PAGE 760 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And she has changed my judgments into wickedness Beyond all the nations, and my statutes beyond all the surrounding people: They have despised my judgments, And have not walked in my statutes.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Therefore, thus says the, Lord Jehovah, Because of your multiplication more than the nations round about you, And your not walking in my statutes, and not keeping my judgments, And your not acting like the nations around you, <span style="color:#800000">8</span> Wherefore, thus says the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I ant against thee, even I: And I will execute my judgments in the midst of thee Before the eyes of the Gentiles.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And I will execute against thee what I never yet have done, Nor will ever do in future, On account of all your abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Therefore fathers shall devour their sons, And sons their fathers, in the midst of thee: I will execute judgments against thee, And disperse all thy remnants to all winds of heaven.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Because I live, says the Lord Jehovah, Since you has polluted my sanctuary <span style="color:#800000">[^f573]</span> With all thy detestable and abominable things, Therefore I will break thee in pieces: My eye shall not spare, neither will I pity thee.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> A third part shall die of the pestilence, And be consumed by famine in the midst of thee; A third part shall be consumed by the sword round about thee; A third part will I disperse towards every wind, And will draw out a sword after them.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, And I will cause my burning anger to rest upon them; And I will enjoy consolation; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, Who have spoken in my zeal, when I shall have accomplished my fury on them.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Moreover, I will lay thee waste, And make thee a reproach among the nations around thee In the eyes of every passer by.

<!-- PAGE 761 -->

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> So you shall be a reproach and a reviling, A chastisement and an astonishment to the nations round about thee, While I shall execute judgments against thee In anger and burning, and furious rebukes. I Jehovah have spoken it.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine For their destruction, which I shall dart upon them to destroy them; <span style="color:#800000">[^f574]</span>

Then will I add famine against them, And will break their staff of bread.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Then will I send against you famine and wild beasts, And they shall bereave you: and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; And I will cause the sword to come upon thee. <span style="color:#800000">[^f575]</span> I Jehovah have spoken it.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> The word also of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> Son of man! set thy face towards the mountain of Israel, And prophesy against them, and say, <span style="color:#800000">3</span> You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus says the Lord Jehovah to the mountains and the inns, To the rivers and the valleys: Behold! I will bring the sword against you, and destroy your high places;

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> And your altars shall be desolate, Your idols shall be broken; And I will cast down your slain before your idols.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Then I will place the carcass of the sons of Israel Before your idols; I will scatter them before the idols. I will sprinkle your bones round about your altars.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> In all your habitations cities shall be desolate, <span style="color:#800000">[^f576]</span>And high places shall be reduced to devastation, That your altars may be wasted and desolated, And your idols may be broken up and abolished, And your images cut. down, and your works blotted out.

<!-- PAGE 762 -->

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then the slain shall fall in the midst of you, And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Still, I will leave a remnant, that you may have some Who shall escape the sword among the nations, When you shall be scattered through the countries.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And the remnant shall remember me among the nations, Among which they shall become captives, Because I am. broken down with their adulterous heart, Which has departed from me, and with their eyes, Which are full of lust after their idols; And they shall loathe themselves for all the evils Which they have committed in all their abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Then they shall know that I Jehovah said not in vain, I will cause them to suffer this evil. <span style="color:#800000">[^f577]</span> <span style="color:#800000">11</span> Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Strike with thy hand, and stamp with thy feet, And say, Alas! for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, For they shall fall by the sword, and famine, and pestilence.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> He who shall be afar off shall die by the pestilence; He who shall be near shall fall by the sword; <span style="color:#800000">[^f578]</span> He who shall remain and be besieged shall die through hunger; And I will fulfill my indignation upon them.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> And you shall know that I am Jehovah, When their wounded shall be among their idols round about their altars, Upon every high hill, in, on all the heads of the mountains, Under every green tree and every thick oak, In the place where they offered the incense of sweet fragrance to all their idols.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> So I will stretch out my hand upon them, And I will make the land desert and desolate — More than the desert of Diblathah, in all their dwellings; And they shall know that I am Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 763 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> You also, son of man, thus says the Lord Jehovah Concerning the land of Israel, All end, an end is come Upon the four quarters of the land.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Now an end is come upon thee, And I will send my indignation against thee, And I will judge thee according to thy ways, And I will put upon thee all your abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then mine eye shall not spare thee, nor will I pity thee; Because I will recompense thy ways upon thee, And thy abominations shall be in the midst of thee, And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Lo! evil, and only evil shall come.

<h2 class="scripture-anchor" id="f579" data-ref="F579" style="display:none">F579</h2>

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> An end is come — an end is come; It has watched against thee; behold! it is come.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> The morning is come upon thee, e dweller in the land; The time is come; the day of tumult is near, and not the clamor of the mountains.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Now I will shortly pour out my indignation upon thee, And I will accomplish my anger against thee, And I will judge thee according to thy ways, And I will put upon thee all thine abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Mine eye shall not spare, neither will I pity; According to thy ways will I put upon thee, And your abominations shall be in the midst of thee; And you shall know that I Jehovah am smiting thee.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Behold the day: behold it is come; The morning has advanced, the rod has flourished;

<!-- PAGE 764 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Pride has flourished: violence has sprung up into a staff of impiety: None of them, nor yet their opulence, shall remain: There shall be no noise nor any lamentation for them:

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> The appointed time is come; the day has approached: The buyer shall not rejoice; the seller shall not be sorrowful; Because indignation shall be on all their multitude.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Since the seller shall not return to his merchandise, And their life is yet among the living; Because the vision is concerning the whole multitude, <span style="color:#800000">[^f580]</span> It shall not return; and no man shall strengthen his soul in his iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> They have blown the trumpet; they have prepared all things; But none is gone out to battle, because my wrath Is upon the whole multitude.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> The sword abroad; pestilence and famine at home. He that is in the field shall die by the sword; He that is in the city shall be consumed by famine and pestilence.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> And the escapers of them shall escape, And shall be upon the inns like doves of the valleys, All mourning, <span style="color:#800000">[^f581]</span> every one in his iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> All hands shall be loosened; all knees shall flow like water.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And they shall gird themselves with sackcloth, And dread shall cover them, And shame shall be upon all faces, And baldness upon all heads.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> They shall east their silver into the street, And their gold shall be an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold shall not deliver them In the day of. Jehovah’s wrath: They shall neither satisfy their souls nor fill their bellies, Because it was; the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> As to the beauty of their ornaments, they turned it to pride, And they made the images of their abominations And of their defilement’s out of it (i.e., gold) <span style="color:#800000">[^f582]</span> Therefore I have east it from them.

<!-- PAGE 765 -->

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> And I will deliver it into the hand of strangers for a prey, And of the wicked of the land for a spoil; And they shall profane it.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> My face also will I turn from them, For they will profane my secret place: And robbers will enter into it and profane it.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Make a chain: — for the, land is fined With a judgment of bloods, The city, too, is full of violence.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> For I will bring on it the wicked among the Gentiles; And they shall possess their houses: I will also cause their pride to cease, And their sanctuaries shall be polluted.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> Destruction is come and they shall seek peace when there is none.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Calamity shall come upon calamity, and rumor upon rumor; Then they shall seek a vision from a prophet; But the law shall perish from the priest, And counsel from the aged.

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> The king shall mourn, and the princes shall be clothed with desolation, And the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: According to their ways will I act towards them, According to their judgments will I judge them. And they shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> And it happened in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judea were sitting before my face, and there the hand of the Lord Jehovah fell upon me.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> I looked, and behold a likeness as the appearance of fire: From the appearance of its loins downwards, fire; And from its loins upwards, as the appearance of brightness, Like the figure of Hasmal.

<!-- PAGE 766 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And he sent the likeness of a hand, And raised ma by a lock of my head; And the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, And led me to Jerusalem in the visions of God, To the door of the inner gate looking towards the north; Where was the seat of the idol jealousy, causing jealousy.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then lo! there was the glory of the God of Israel, According to the vision which I saw in the plain.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> And said to me, Son of man, lift up your eyes now To the way of the north: So I raised my eyes towards the north, And lo! towards the north at the gate of the altar, That idol — jealousy — at the entrance.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And he said to me, Son of man, seest you their deeds? The great abominations which the house of Israel perpetrate here, That I should depart far from my sanctuary? But turn thee yet again, and you shall see greater abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then he led m, to the door of the court, And I looked, and lo! an opening in the wall. Then he said to me, Son of man, dig now into the wall; And I dug in the wall, and behold a door.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Then he said to me, Enter and see the evil abominations which they do.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Then I entered and beheld, and lo! every likeness of a reptile, <span style="color:#800000">10</span> And abominations of animals, and, all idols of the house of Israel, Were depicted on the wall round about.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, And Jazaniah, son of Saphan, stood in the midst of them, Who stood before them, and to each r, censer in his hand, And a thick cloud of incense ascended.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then he said to, me, Has you seen, son of mall, What the elders of the house of Israel do in darkness, Each in the hidden places of his imagery? Who say, Jehovah does not see us; Jehovah has deserted the land.

<!-- PAGE 767 -->

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Then he said to me, Turn thee again, And you shall see the great abominations which they do.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Jehovah’s house, Which looks to the north: and lo! there sat women Lamenting for Thammuz.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> Then he said to me, Son of man, turn thee again, And you shall see greater abominations than these.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Then he led me to the inner court of Jehovah’s house, And lo! at the gate of Jehovah’s temple, between the entrance and the altar, About five and twenty men, with their backs towards Jehovah’s temple, And their faces towards the east, worshipping the rising sun.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Then he said to me, Has you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judea To do these abominations which they have done there? Because they have fined the land with violence, And have returned to provoke me, And lo! they put the branch to their nose.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> I also in return will deal in my fury: Mine eye shall neither spare nor pity; And when they cry in mine ears with a loud voice I will not hear them.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> He cried also in mine ear with a loud voice, saying, Let the rulers of the city approach, Every one with his weapon of destruction in his hand.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> And lo! six men coming from the way of the higher gate, which is towards the north, And each had his slaughter-weapon in his hand; And one man in the midst of them clothed in linen, With a writer’s inkhorn at his side: Then they went in and stood near the brazen altar.

<!-- PAGE 768 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Then the glory of the God of Israel ascended from the cherubim Above which it rested, to the threshold of the house, And cried to the man clothed in linen, with the inkhorn at his side;

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then Jehovah said to him, Pass through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, And make a sign upon the foreheads of the men who sigh And cry for all the abominations which they suffer in the midst of it.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> But to the others he said in my hearing, Go you after, him through the city, and smite; Let not your eye spare, and do not pity:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Old and young, girl, boy, and woman slay to the death; Yet approach not any who bears the sign, And begin from my sanctuary. Then they began at the elders who were in front of the house.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> And he said to them, Pollute the house, and fill the altars with the slain: Go you forth. And they went forth, and made a slaughter in the city.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And it happened while they were slaying that I was left: Then I fell upon my face, and cried out and said, Aha! Lord Jehovah, wilt you slay all the relics of Israel By pouring forth your anger upon Jerusalem?

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Then he said to me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judea Is great beyond measure, and the land is full of blood, And the city is full of perversity: because they said, Jehovah has deserted the land: Jehovah regardeth it not.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> As for me also, mine eye shall not spare them, I will not pity them their ways will I recompense on their heads.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> And lo! the man clad in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, Returned and made his report., saying, I have done as you did command me.

<!-- PAGE 769 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then I looked, and lo! above the firmament, which was above the head of the cherubim, As it were a sapphire-stone, Like the appearance of a throne which was seen above them.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Then he spoke to the mall clad in linen garments, and said, Go in to the midst of the wheels under the cherub, And fill thy palms with coals of fire from the midst of the cherubim, And scatter them over the cry. And he went in my sight.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And the cherubim stood on the right of the house when the man came. And a cloud fined the inner court.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then the glory of Jehovah was raised above the cherub towards the threshold of the house; And the house was fined with cloud, And the court was fined with the brightness of Jehovah’s glory.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Then the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard to the outer court, Like the voice of the Omnipotent God when he speaketh.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> And it happened when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, Saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from the midst of the cherubim; Then he went in and stood beside the wheel.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> And one cherub stretched His hand from the midst of the cherubim, To the fire which was in the midst of the cherubim, And he took it, and put it into the palms of the man clothed in linen; Then he took it and departed.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> And there appeared in the cherubim themselves, The likeness of a man’s hand under their wings.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Then I looked, and lo! four wheels near the cherubhis, One wheel by one cherub, another wheel near another cherub: And the appearance of the wheels was like the stone tharsis.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> And as for their aspect, the appearance of each was the same, <span style="color:#800000">[^f583]</span> As if a wheel was in the midst of a wheel.

<!-- PAGE 770 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> When they moved, they went on their four sides; They did not return in going forward, Since they moved towards the direction of their head; They did not return as they went.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And their whole body, and backs, and hands, and wings, The four wheels, indeed, themselves were full of eyes all round. is He cried to the wheels in my hearing, O wheel!

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> And each living creature had four faces: The face of the first that of a cherub; The face of the second that of a. man; Of the third that of a lion; and the fourth an eagle’s.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> And the cherubim were raised up. This is the living creature which I saw by the river Chebar.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Then when the cherubim moved, the wheels moved near them; And when the cherubim raised their wings aloft From the earth, The wheels did not turn away from the side of them.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> When the living creatures stood, they stood; When they were lifted up, the wheels also were raised: Because the spirit of the living creature was in them.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Then the glory of Jehovah went forth from the threshold of the house, And stood over the cherubim.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Then the cherubim raised their wings, and went up from the earth in my sight: When they went forth, the wheels also went before them, And each stood above the threshold of the east gate of Jehovah’s house; And the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> It is the very living creature which I saw Under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; And I knew them to be cherubim.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Each had four faces apiece, and four wings; And the likeness of the hands of a man under their wings.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> And the likeness of their faces was that which I saw at the river Chebar, Both their appearance and themselves: <span style="color:#800000">[^f584]</span> Each moved towards his own face.

<!-- PAGE 771 -->

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then the spirit raised me up, and brought me To the eastern gate of Jehovah’s house; and lo! At the threshold of the gate, five and twenty men; Then I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah, son of Asur; And Pelthiah, son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Then he said to me, Son of man, these men divine vanity, And plan perverse counsel in this city;

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Who say, It is not near; let us build houses: The city is the caldron, and we are the flesh:

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Wherefore, prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Then the Spirit of Jehovah fell upon me, and said to me, Say, Thus saith Jehovah, Thus have you spoken, O house of Israel, The mountings of your spirit, I know them:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> You have multiplied your slain in this city, And you have fined its streets with the slain.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Wherefore, thus says the Lord Jehovah, Your slain, Whom you placed in the midst — they shall be the flesh, And the city the caldron; and I will cast you forth from the midst of it:

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> You have feared the sword, and I will bring the sword upon you, saith the Lord Jehovah:

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And I will eas, you out of the midst of it. And will deliver you h, to the hand of strangers, And will exercise judgments against you.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Then you shall fall by the sword: in the border of Israel Will I judge you; and you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> It shall not be your caldron, And you shall not be in the midst of it for flesh; In the border of Israel will I judge you.

<!-- PAGE 772 -->

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> And you shall, Know that I am Jehovah; Because you ha, re not; walked in my statutes, And have not executed my judgments; But you have done according to the judgments of the nations around you.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> And it happened, while I prophesied, That Phalatias, the son of Benaiah, died: Then I fell upon my face, and cried with loud voice, and said, Ah! Lord Jehovah! will you consume the remnant of Israel!

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me again, saying, <span style="color:#800000">15</span> Son of man, thy brethren, thy brethren, Thy kindred, and all the whole house of Israel, To these the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Depart you far from Jehovah, the land is given as an heritage to us.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Wherefore say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because you have been east far away among the Gentiles, And dispersed through the lands, Therefore will I be to them a sanctuary of fewness <span style="color:#800000">[^f585]</span>

<p style="margin-left:2em;" markdown="1">In the lands to which they have come.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Wherefore you shall say, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, I will gather you out of the peoples, and collect you out of the lands To which you have been driven, and I will give you the land of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And they shall come there, and take away all its idols, And all its abominations out of it.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Then I will give them one hear, and will put a new Spirit within them; And I will take away the stony heart from their flesh, And will give them a heart of flesh:

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> That. they may walk in my statutes, And keep my judgments, and do them: Then they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Then I will repay on their own head the way of those Whose heart walks after, heart of foulness <span style="color:#800000">[^f586]</span> and grossness, Saith the Lord Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 773 -->

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Then the cherubim raised their wings, and the wheels beside them, And the glory of the God of Israel was over above them.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> And the glory of Jehovah ascended out of the midst of the city, And stood over the mount on the east of the city.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> Then the spirit raised me, and brought me to Chaldsea, To the captivity, In a vision, in t. he Spirit of God. Then the vision which I saw went up from me.

<p style="text-align:center" markdown="1"><span style="color:#800000">25</span> And I spoke to the captivity All the words of Jehovah which he had shown me.</p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> The word of Jehovah came also unto me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> Son of man, you dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house: They have eyes to see, and they see not; They have ears to hear, and they hear not, Because their house is revoking.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And you, son of man, make thyself vessels for removal, And remove in the day-time before their eyes: Then you shall move from thy place to another in their sight, Since perhaps they may consider, for they are a rebellious house <span style="color:#800000">4</span> And bring forth vessels like vessels for removal In the day-time in their sight: And you shall go forth at even in their sight, Like a departure into captivity.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> In their sight; you shall dig thyself a wall, And carry out (thy goods) by it:

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> In their eyes upon thy shoulder shall you carry (them); In darkness shall you go forth: You shall cover thy face, and not look upon the ground, Because I have placed thee as a sign to the house of Israel.

<!-- PAGE 774 -->

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then I did as I was commanded. My vessels I carried forth like vessels for captivity In the daytime; Then in the evening I dug through the wall by my hand; <span style="color:#800000">[^f587]</span> In the darkness I led them forth, Upon my shoulder I carried them in their sight.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Then in the morning the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">9</span> Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to thee, <span style="color:#800000">10</span> What doest you? Say to them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This burden <span style="color:#800000">[^f588]</span> relates to the prince in Jerusalem, And to all the house of Israel in the midst of them.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Say unto them, I am your portent: As I have done, so shall it be done to them: They shall be taken away and led into captivity.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then the prince in the midst of them Shall carry on his shoulder in the darkness, And go forth through the wall, Through which they have dug for carrying out by it: He shall cover his face so as not to look upon the ground.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Then I will spread my net over him, and he shall be taken in my snare: Then I will lead him away to Babylon in the land of Chaldea; Yet he shall not see it, though he shall die there.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> And all who are about him to help him, and all his garrison, Will I scatter to every wind, and I will unsheath my sword after them <span style="color:#800000">[^f589]</span> <span style="color:#800000">15</span> Then they shall know that I ant Jehovah, After I shall have scattered them among the nations, And shall have dispersed them through their lands.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> And I will make the remnant of them but few By the sword, and famine, and pestilence; That they may narrate all their abominations Among the Gentiles to whom they come; And they shall know that; I am Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 775 -->
<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Moreover, the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">18</span> Son of man, eat thy bread with trembling, and drink thy water With tumult and anxiety: And you shall say to the people of the land, <span style="color:#800000">19</span> Thus says the Lord Jehovah to the dwellers at Jerusalem, And on the land of Israel, They shall eat their bread in torture, <span style="color:#800000">[^f590]</span>

And shall drink their water in desolation, That the land rosy be spoiled of its fullness, On account of the violence of all its inhabitants.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> And inhabited cities shall be reduced to solitude, And the land laid waste; and you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">22</span> Son of man, What is this proverb of yours in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prostrated, and all prophecy has ceased? Wherefore you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, I will make this proverb cease, And they shall no more use this proverb in Israel; But rather say to them, The days are at hand, And the word of every vision.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> Because there shall no longer be any lying vision, Nor any flattering divination in the midst of the house of Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> Since I Jehovah will speak: And the word which I shall speak, I will also perform; It shall no longer be prolonged: Since in your days, O exasperating house, The word which I shall speak, I will perform, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">27</span> Son of man, behold the house of Israel say, The vision which he saw is extended to many days, And he prophesieth for times afar off.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> Wherefore you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, It shall not be put off any longer; All the words which I have spoken, even every word, Will I fulfill, says the Lord Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 776 -->

<p class="title-block-h2" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin:18px 0 12px;" markdown="1"><span style="color:#006411">CHAPTER 13.</span></p>

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel That prophesy, and say unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear you the word of Jehovah;

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Wo unto the foolish prophets, Who walk after their own spirit, and have seen nothing! <span style="color:#800000">[^f591]</span> <span style="color:#800000">4</span> Like foxes in the deserts, are thy prophets, O Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> You have not gone up to the broken places, Nor repaired the hedge around the house of Israel, To stand in the battle in the day of Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> They have seen vanity, they have divined a he, Saying, Jehovah says, and Jehovah has not sent them; And they caused men to hope for the confirmation of their word.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Have you not seen a vision of vanity, and spoken a divination of is? And yet you say Jehovah says it, and I have not spoken it.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Wherefore thus says the Lord Jehovah, <span style="color:#800000">[^f592]</span> Because you have spoken vanity, and have seen a he, Wherefore behold! I am against t. hem, Says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And my hand shall be against the prophets who see vanity and divine a lie: They shall not be in the counsel of my people, And shall not be written in the catalogue of the house of Israel, And they shall not return to the land of Israel; And you shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Because, even because, they have deceived my people, By saying, Peace, and there was no peace: And one built up a wall, and, behold, others daubed it with untempered mortar:

<!-- PAGE 777 -->

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Say to those who daub it with untempered mortar, It shall fall: There shall be an inundating shower: And I will send hailstones; And the breath of whirlwinds shall rend it.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Lo! the wall shall fall: shall it not be said to you, Where is the daubing with which you have daubed it?

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> Besides, thus says the Lord Jehovah, I will make it fall: <span style="color:#800000">[^f593]</span>

There shall be the breath. of tempests in my wrath, And an inundating shower in my anger, And hailstones in my fury to consume them.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Then I will overthrow the wall which you have daubed with untempered mortar, And I will bring it down to the ground; Then its foundation shall be discovered when it shall fall, And you shall be consumed in the midst of it; And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> I will also satisfy mine indignation upon the wall As well as upon its daubing, and will say to them, The wall is gone, and the daubers of it are no more.

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> The prophets of Israel prophesied concerning Jerusalem, And saw a vision of peace for it; Yet there is no peace, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Son of man, do you set thy face against the daughters of thy people, Who prophesy out of their own heart, and prophesy against them, <span style="color:#800000">18</span> And you shall say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Wo to those who sow pillows to all armholes, And make coverings for the head of every stature, To hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people? And will you preserve your own souls alive?

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Will you profane me before my people for handfuls of barley and pieces of bread, To slay the souls that were not dying, And to give life to the souls that were not alive, By deceiving my people who listen to your is?

<!-- PAGE 778 -->

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Because thus says the Lord Jehovah, Behold! I am against your pillows by which you there hunt souls for their escape; And I will tear them from your arms, And set free the souls which you have hunted, that they may escape.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> I will also rend your coverings, and deliver my people out of your hands; They shall no longer be a prey in your hands; And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> Because you have grieved the heart of the just by falsehood, And I have not grieved him; And you have strengthened the hands of the wicked, So that he should not be converted from his evil way <span style="color:#800000">23</span> For saving his life: wherefore you shall not see a he Nor divine a divination any more; For I will rescue my people from your hands: And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then men came to me from the elders of Israel, And sat before my face.

<span style="color:#800000">2</span> Then came the word of Jehovah to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">3</span> Son of man, these men have set their idols up in their heart, And have put a stumbling block of iniquity before their face. Shall I verily be inquired of by them?

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Wherefore speak unto them, and say, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Every man of the house of Israel, who setteth up his idols in his heart, And has put the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, And has come to the Prophet; I Jehovah Will answer him according to the multitude of his idols; <span style="color:#800000">[^f594]</span> <span style="color:#800000">5</span> That I may seize the house of Israel in their own heart, Because they have entirely separated themselves from me by their idols.

<!-- PAGE 779 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Turn you, Even turn yourselves from your idols; And turn your faces from all your abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> For every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers sojourning in Israel, Who is separated <span style="color:#800000">[^f595]</span> from following after me, And has set up his idols in his heart, And put the stumbling-block of his iniquity before his face, And cometh to the Prophet to inquire of me through him; I Jehovah will answer him for myself.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Then will I set my face against that man, And set him for a sign and a proverb, And I will cut him off from the midst of my people; And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> And when a prophet is deceived in uttering his speech, I Jehovah have deceived that prophet; And I will stretch forth my hand upon him, And will blot him out of the midst of my people Israel.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> They shall also bear their iniquity; As the iniquity of the inquirer, so shall be the iniquity of the prophet;

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> That the house of Israel may stray from me no more, Neither be polluted any more with all their wickedness; That they may be my people, and I may be their God, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">13</span> Son of man, when a land has acted wickedly against me, <span style="color:#800000">[^f596]</span> And I shall stretch out my hand upon it, And shall break the staff of its bread, And shall send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast:

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Though these three men were in it, Noah, Daniel, and Job, They shall deliver but their own souls in their righteousness, Says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> If I cause an evil beast to pass through the land, And it bereave it and lay it waste, So that no man can pass through on account of the beast:

<!-- PAGE 780 -->

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> Though these three men were in it, as I live, says the Lord Jehovah, If they shall deliver their own souls, They alone shall be delivered, and the land shall be laid waste.

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> Or if I make a sword pass through that land, And I say to the sword, Pass through the land, So that: man. and beast may be cut off from it:

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> And these three men are in the midst of it, As I live, says the Lord Jehovah, They shall not deliver their sons and their daughters, Since they alone shall be set free.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> Or if I shall send a pestilence upon that land, And pour out my wrath upon it in blood, To destroy from it man and beast:

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> And Noah, Daniel, and Job were in the midst of it, As I live, says the Lord Jehovah, They shall not deliver either son or daughter; They shall free their own soul in their righteousness.

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Therefore thus says the Lord Jehovah, How much more when I send my four grievous judgments against Jerusalem, The sword, and famine, and evil beast, to destroy from it man and beast?

<span style="color:#800000">22</span> And lo! the remnant that is left in it, <span style="color:#800000">[^f597]</span> The remnant of those who go forth, namely, sons and daughters, They shall go forth unto you: And you shall see their ways and their works, And you shall console yourselves for all the evil Which I have brought upon Jerusalem, Yea, all that I have brought upon her.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> Then shall you be comforted when you shall see their ways and their works: And you shall know that I have not done in vain Whatever I have done in it, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then came the word of Jehovah unto me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> Son of man, What is the wood of the vine Better than any branching-tree among the trees of the wood?

<!-- PAGE 781 -->

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Shall wood be taken from it to form any work? Or will it make a peg to hang any vessel thereon?

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Behold, it is east into the fire for burning; The fire devoured both ends of it, and its middle is burnt <span style="color:#800000">[^f598]</span> Is it useful for any purpose?

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> Lo! when it was entire, it was not used for any purpose: How much less when the fire has consumed it, And it is burnt up, shall it be useful for any purpose?

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Therefore thus says the Lord Jehovah, As the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, Which I have cast into the fire for fuel, So have I given the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then will I set my face against them; They shall pass through fire, and fire shall consume them; And they shall know that I am Jehovah, When I have set my face against them.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Then will I make the land desolate, Because they have transgressed with transgression <span style="color:#800000">[^f599]</span> Says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> Son of man, lay open to Jerusalem her abominations.

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> Thus shall you say, Thus says the Lord Jehovah unto Jerusalem, Thy source and thy birth-place was the land of Canaan; Thy father was an Amorite, thy mother a Hittite.

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> Then as to thy nativity, in the day of thy birth, Thy navel was not cut: you was not washed with water To supple thee: you was not salted with salt, <span style="color:#800000">[^f600]</span> Nor wrapped in swaddling clothes.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> No eye pitied thee, to do unto thee any one of these things, In considering thee; and you was cast forth On the surface of the field, to the disgrace of thy person, in the day of thy birth.

<!-- PAGE 782 -->

<span style="color:#800000">6</span> Then I passed near thee and saw thy defilement’s, And I said to thee in thy bloods, Live; Yea, I said to thee in thy bloods, Live.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> Then I made thee grow as a germ of the field, And you did increase and flourish; You became remarkably beautiful; <span style="color:#800000">[^f601]</span> Thy breasts became prominent and your hair profuse, Yet you was naked and bare.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> Then I passed by and saw thee: and lo! the time, the time for love: Then I stretched out my skirt over thee, And covered thy nakedness; and I swore to thee, And made a covenant with thee, And you was mine, saith the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">9</span> Then I washed thee with water, and cleansed thy blood from thee, And anointed thee with oil. and clothed thee in a Phrygian robe;

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Then I shod thee with badgers’ skin, and dressed thee in fine linen; Then I arrayed thee in silk, and adorned thee with ornaments, <span style="color:#800000">11</span> And put bracelets on thy hands, and a chain round thy Deck.

<span style="color:#800000">12</span> Then I put a ring through thy nose, <span style="color:#800000">[^f602]</span> and earrings in your ears, And a crown of comeliness on thy head.

<span style="color:#800000">13</span> I adorned thee with gold and silver, and clothed thee with fine linen, And silk and broidered work you did eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; And you was beautiful exceedingly, And you did proceed prosperously to thy kingdom.

<span style="color:#800000">14</span> Then thy fame went forth among the nations for beauty, Because you was perfect in the beauty Which I caused unto thee, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">15</span> But you did trust in thy beauty, and commit fornication through thy renown, And did pour out thy fornications to every passer by;

<!-- PAGE 783 -->

<span style="color:#800000">16</span> His it was. — Then you has taken of thy garments, And made thee high places sprinkled with spots, And has committed fornication upon them: They do not come, and it shall not be.

<h2 class="scripture-anchor" id="f603" data-ref="F603" style="display:none">F603</h2>

<span style="color:#800000">17</span> You has also taken vessels of thy beauty of my gold And of my silver which I had given thee; And you has made for thyself images of men, And has committed fornication with them.

<span style="color:#800000">18</span> Then you has taken of thy variegated garments, And has clothed them: and my oil and mine incense Has you set before them.

<span style="color:#800000">19</span> My bread also which, I gave thee, fine flour and oil, And honey with which I fed thee, You has set it before them for a sweet savor; And so it has happened, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">20</span> Then you has taken thy sons and thy daughters which you has borne to me, And has slain them to be devoured: Are then thy fornications a small thing?

<span style="color:#800000">21</span> Then you has slain my sons, and caused them to be thrown to idols. <span style="color:#800000">[^f604]</span> <span style="color:#800000">22</span> And in all your abominations and thy lewdness You has not remembered the days of thy youth, When you was naked and bare, and defiled in thy bloods.

<span style="color:#800000">23</span> So after all thy wickedness it has happened to thee, Wo! wo! unto thee, says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">24</span> Then you has built a high place for thyself, And has made thee a raised spot in every street.

<span style="color:#800000">25</span> At the head of every way you has built thy high place; Then you has made thy beauty abominable, And has spread thy feet to every passer by, And has multiplied thy lewdness’.

<span style="color:#800000">26</span> You has also committed adultery with the Egyptians Thy neighbors, great of flesh: and over and over again Has committed lewdness to irritate me.

<!-- PAGE 784 -->

<span style="color:#800000">27</span> Then lo! I stretched out my hand over thee, And I diminished thy portion, and delivered thee up To the lust of the daughters of the Philistines, who hated thee, And were ashamed of your abandoned ways.

<span style="color:#800000">28</span> Then you has committed adultery with the sons of Ashur, Since you was not satisfied, you has been lewd with them; Yet even then you was not, satisfied.

<span style="color:#800000">29</span> Then you has increased thy lewdnesses In the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; And even this did not satiate thee.

<span style="color:#800000">30</span> How soft is your heart, says the Lord Jehovah, Since you doest all the work of a bold abandoned woman!

<span style="color:#800000">31</span> Since you has raised your high place at the head of every way, And has made thy lofty place in every celebrated spot; And has not been like a harlot in scorning hire. <span style="color:#800000">[^f605]</span> <span style="color:#800000">32</span> An adulterous woman receiving strangers instead of her husband!

<span style="color:#800000">33</span> To all harlots men give a reward; But you has given thy gifts to all thy lovers, And you has hired them to come to thee from all sides <span style="color:#800000">34</span> For thy fornications — for in thy lewdness You have inverted the custom of other women; Since there is no fornication like thine: Because you has given instead of receiving a gift, Then you has acted contrary to others.

<span style="color:#800000">35</span> Wherefore, O harlot, hear Jehovah’s word!

<span style="color:#800000">36</span> Thus says the Lord Jehovah, Because thy shamelessness is poured out, And thy baseness detected in thy lewdness towards thy lovers, And towards all the idols of your abominations, And in the bloods of thy children whom you has given to them;

<span style="color:#800000">37</span> Wherefore lo! I will assemble all thy lovers Whom you has attracted, and all whom you has loved and hated; I will assemble them from all around thee, And I will lay bare thy nakedness before them, And they shall behold all thy turpitude.

<!-- PAGE 785 -->

<span style="color:#800000">38</span> Then will I judge thee with the judgment of adulteresses, And of those who pour out blood; and I will give thee The blood of fury and of jealousy.

<span style="color:#800000">39</span> And I will give thee into their hand, And they shall pull down thy high place, And destroy thy raised places, and shall spoil thee of thy robes; They shall also take the vessels of thy glory, And send thee away, naked and bare.

<span style="color:#800000">40</span> Then they shall stir up a crowd against thee, And stone thee with stones, and thrust at thee with swords.

<span style="color:#800000">41</span> Then they shall burn thy houses with fire, And shall execute judgments against thee in the eyes of many women: Then will I cause thee to cease from fornication, Neither shall you offer a gift any more.

<span style="color:#800000">42</span> And I will cause my fury towards thee to rest, And my jealousy shall depart from thee, And I will rest and be no longer angry.

<span style="color:#800000">43</span> Because you has not remembered the days of thy youth, But has provoked me in all those things; I will even recompense thy way upon your head, Says the Lord Jehovah; since you has taken no thought For all your abominations. <span style="color:#800000">[^f606]</span> <span style="color:#800000">44</span> Lo! every user of proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, Saying, As the mother is, so is the daughter.

<span style="color:#800000">45</span> You art the daughter of thy mother, who has east away her husband and her sons; And the sister of thy sisters, who loathe their husbands and children; Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite:

<span style="color:#800000">46</span> And your elder sister is Samaria, and her daughters those who dwell at thy left hand; And thy younger sister, who dwells at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

<span style="color:#800000">47</span> Yet you has not walked in their ways, And you has not done according to their abominations, As if it had been a very small firing, And you has been more corrupt than they in all thy ways.

<!-- PAGE 786 -->

<span style="color:#800000">48</span> As I live, says the Lord Jehovah, If Sodom thy sister and her daughters have done As you and thy daughters have done.

<span style="color:#800000">49</span> Lo! this was the iniquity of Sodom thy sister, Pride, fullness of bread, and security of ease Belonged to her and her daughters and she did not lay hold Of the hand of the poor and needy; but she was haughty, <span style="color:#800000">50</span> And did abomination before me, Hence I took them away as it pleased me. <span style="color:#800000">[^f607]</span> <span style="color:#800000">51</span> And Samaria has not committed half of thy sins; But you has multiplied your abominations beyond them, And has justified thy sisters in all the abominations which you has done.

<span style="color:#800000">52</span> Bear you, then, thy disgrace by which you has pleaded for thy sister, By thy crimes which you has committed beyond them; They are justified more than you be you then ashamed, And bear thy disgrace, since you has justified thy sisters.

<span style="color:#800000">53</span> Yet will I turn the captivity, yea, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, And the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, And the captivity of thy captivities in the midst of them, <span style="color:#800000">54</span> That you mayest bear thy reproach, and mayest be ashamed Of all that you has done in consoling them.

<span style="color:#800000">55</span> And thy sisters Sodom and her daughters shall return to their former state, And Samaria and her daughters shall return to theirs, And you and thy daughters shall return to yours.

<span style="color:#800000">56</span> Then thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thee, In the day of thy pride, before thy wickedness was detected;

<span style="color:#800000">57</span> As in the time of thy reproach from the daughters of Syria, And from all around of the daughters of the Philistines, Who despised thee round about.

<span style="color:#800000">58</span> As for thy depraved thoughts and abominations, You has borne them, says Jehovah.

<!-- PAGE 787 -->

<span style="color:#800000">59</span> For thus saith the Lord Jehovah, I will also do to thee as you has done, Who has despised the oath and broken the covenant.

<span style="color:#800000">60</span> Yet I will remember my covenant with thee In the days of thy youth, and I will establish a perpetual covenant with thee.

<span style="color:#800000">61</span> Then you shall remember thy ways and be ashamed, When you shall receive thy sisters, both elder and younger than thyself; And I will give them unto thee for daughters, But not by thy covenant.

<span style="color:#800000">62</span> For I will establish my covenant with thee, And you shall know that I am Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">63</span> That you mayest remember and be ashamed, And not open thy mouth any more because of thy disgrace, When I am propitious to thee for all thy deeds, Says the Lord Jehovah.

<span style="color:#800000">1</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">2</span> Son of man, put forth an enigma and utter a proverb to the house of Israel;

<span style="color:#800000">3</span> And say, Thus says the Lord Jehovah, A mighty eagle, with great wings, long feathers, and full of plumage, Of various colors, came to Mount Lebanon, And took the highest branch of a cedar;

<span style="color:#800000">4</span> He cropped off the top of its young twigs, And carried it into the land of the merchant; He planted it in a city of merchants.

<span style="color:#800000">5</span> He took also of the seed of the land, And put it in a fruitful field; He planted it near many waters, like a willow. <span style="color:#800000">[^f608]</span> <span style="color:#800000">6</span> Then it grew and became a luxuriant vine, low of stature, So that its branches turned towards the eagle, And its roots were under him; and it became a vine, And brought forth branches, and sent out boughs.

<span style="color:#800000">7</span> There was also another large eagle, <span style="color:#800000">[^f609]</span> of great wings and of copious plumage, And lo! this vine bent its roots towards him, And sent forth its branches towards him, That he might water it from the beds of his plantation.

<span style="color:#800000">8</span> In a good soil near many streams was it planted, That it should produce leaves and bring forth fruit, So as to be a magnificent vine.

<span style="color:#800000">10</span> Yet, behold, when planed, shall it prosper? Shall it not completely wither when the east wind has touched it.? Upon the beds of its plantation shall it wither.

<span style="color:#800000">11</span> Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, <span style="color:#800000">12</span> Say, I pray thee, to the rebellious house, Know you not what this means? AS CALVIN’S LATIN TRANSLATION ends here, so the version by the Translator comes naturally to a close. It has not been thought necessary to re-translate from the original the remainder of EZEKIEL, as the previously quoted labors of Newcome and Rosenmuller are sufficiently accessible and explanatory.
